name: getforms
description: Modern, high-performance, open-source form backend and form-to-email service. Free self-hosted & managed cloud alternative to Formspree, Basin, FormBee, and Formcarry with zero-config SQLite WAL, multi-channel notifications, and modern spam protection.
author: Lucky Yaduvanshi <https://github.com/Luckyyaduvanshiofficial>

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
